title: Trump-linked financial flows: disclosed, reported and unresolved
method: Non-additive evidence catalogue. Do not sum disparate recipients, entities, principals, gifts, fees and proceeds.

crypto.note: Cautious vs inclusive independent reading of OGE 2025 filing. Possible duplicated wallet proceeds; not audited personal take-home pay.

guardrails: No wrongdoing or policy influence inferred solely from flow or chronology.
Personal income, entity income, principal routed in third-party deal, future events and government-owned assets are different measurements.
Do not add overlapping World Liberty wallet entries or subset foreign licensing receipts.
Recipient and beneficial owner identities must not be collapsed.
Foreign-located payer is not the same as foreign government payer.
All records display original sources, event date and caveat.
Potential conflicts require independent evidence of power exercised, benefit, and a reasonable counterfactual.
Current legal rules are distinguished from allegations and reform proposals.
Method and evidence standard must apply without regard to party or person.
